name: super-review
description: Exhaustive, evidence-based whole-repository review with explicit invocation.

interface.shortDescription: Exhaustive repository review with one canonical findings report
interface.longDescription: Review a whole repository across engineering, architecture, security, reliability, product, and UX, then maintain one evidence-based canonical FINDINGS.md.
defaultPrompt: $super-review:super-review audit this repository and update its canonical FINDINGS.md.
